title: Riders to the Sea
author: J. M. Synge
license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg License applies to the file (trademark terms)
description: Project Gutenberg #994 plain text (CRLF). Gutenberg header, contents, a two-page introduction by E. J. O'Brien, PERSONS list with first cast run together on wrapped lines. One act, many directions: cue alone on its line ('NORA.'), delivery directions in _underscores_ before an em dash ('_In a low voice._--Where is she?'), [_bracketed_] directions as paragraphs and inline; dialogue resumes after a direction without repeating the cue; a joint cue 'CATHLEEN AND NORA.'.
goldenMethod: gutenberg_riders.py on Gutenberg's HTML of the same release: every italic run inside a speech is a direction (removed with its brackets or trailing em dash, counted); cue-less paragraphs after a direction continue the previous speech. verify.py 122/122 verbatim; spot-checked by hand.
